description: Utility class for logging and inspecting MediaCodec capabilities, including supported resolutions, frame rates, and features, for Android media decoders.

classes.name: MediaCodecCapabilitiesLogger
classes.description: Provides methods to log and analyze MediaCodec capabilities on Android devices.

classes.name: ResolutionAndFrameRate
classes.description: Stores maximum supported resolution and frame rate for a decoder.

methods.name: getSupportedResolutionsAndFrameRates
methods.description: Returns a string describing supported resolutions and frame rates, including HDR capabilities.

methods.name: getLongFormSupportedResolutionsAndFrameRates
methods.description: Returns detailed supported resolutions and frame rates for each configuration.

methods.name: convertResolutionAndFrameRatesToString
methods.description: Converts a list of supported resolutions and frame rates to a human-readable string.

methods.name: ensurefeatureMapInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the feature support map for different codec features based on SDK version.

methods.name: getAllFeatureNames
methods.description: Returns a string listing all supported codec feature names.

methods.name: getSupportedFeaturesAsString
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of supported features for a given codec.

methods.name: dumpAllDecoders
methods.description: Logs detailed information about all available decoders on the system.
